raw_description:
A single corner ornament for the top-left corner of a page — elegant
cartographic flourish with small geometric motifs and a delicate
vine-like curl extending along both edges of the corner.
formatted_prompt: Editorial field-journal ink illustration on aged vellum parchment, square format centered composition with generous negative space. A single top-left corner ornament rendered in fine nib-pen linework: cartographic flourish with small geometric diamond and crosshatch motifs clustered at the corner vertex, delicate vine-like tendrils curling outward along both edges in controlled arcs. Warm vellum ground (#E7E3D5) with slate ink linework in deep navy-charcoal, subtle muted amber wash accenting the geometric nodes. Faint foxing at parchment edges, aged paper grain beneath. Restrained, archival, museum-plate register — no fills beyond thin watercolor tinting, no digital gloss, production-clean silhouette suitable for UI extraction.
